text:
sanjay: Quick kickoff for StratusFabric preview (alpha). Summary: NDA status, bench + telemetry schema, SI integration checklist, and marketplace metadata stub. Assigning owners now.
meera: Ill take NDA tracking and countersign chase. NDA file uploaded: StratusFabric_Redwood_Preview_NDA_2026.pdf. Noted clause: they request joint use of anonymized benchmark graphs and a 48h review window.
owen: I'll build the bench harness. Plan: perf sweep, memory/stability 8h, and quant-mode comparisons (fp16 vs q4_0). Will tag runs with partner:StratusFabric and marketplace:preview.
pat: Product/marketing: hold on any public references until legal + partner sign-off. Marketplace stub should include regions (us-west1, eu-central1), preview SLA=best-effort, and limited availability. I'll draft the stub.
ops-bot: Ops reminder: hardware access requires NDA countersigned and an eng-infra ticket with run_id and access list. Use template: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/CreateIssue?project=PART
meera: Legal flagged the data ownership language. @sophia can you advise on acceptable amendment?
sophia: Suggest amendment: "Redwood and StratusFabric may use aggregated, anonymized benchmark metrics for marketing after mutual sign-off; raw traces may be shared only under a time-limited debug token for troubleshooting and deleted after 90 days unless otherwise agreed." Also add explicit co-marketing approval step (48h review).
sanjay: Sounds good. Owen, please make raw traces gated and default to aggregated-only uploads.
owen: Harness prototype (dev container):
```
./sf_bench --model rwd-13b-qat --seq 1024 --batch 8 --iters 600 \ 
  --telemetry-endpoint https://telemetry.redwood.internal/v2/collect \ 
  --tags partner:StratusFabric,slot:alpha,marketplace:preview \ 
  --flags --aggregated-only
```
owen: Telemetry keys (minimal): ["run_id","model","variant","batch_size","seq_len","tokens_per_sec","p50_ms","p95_ms","p99_ms","vram_pct","gpu_temp_c","partner_project"]. run_id = UUID, partner_project = StratusFabric-alpha.
pat: Marketplace draft: regions us-west1, eu-central1; preview=limited; pricing=TBD; product owner for listing: pat. Will open PR in docs.
meera: On debug traces: propose signed debug token workflow: partner requests token, legal approves, token valid 7 days, auto-delete enforced. Sophia OK?
sophia: Approved in legal thread, but require auditing logs for any raw trace access and a clause that raw device-level logs are never transferred without explicit mutual agreement.
ops-bot: Lab slots: can provision 2 x SF-A16 nodes on Tue 14:00-18:00 if countersign attached to ticket. Submit run_id and attach NDA.
nowen: Sample aggregated log tail:
```
2026-05-10T14:02:12Z INFO run_id=9f3b2e7a-1c4a-4d7b-8f1a-3b2c4d5e6f70 tokens/s=1178.4 p50=11.9ms p95=25.6ms p99=48.2ms vram_pct=72
2026-05-10T14:07:12Z INFO run_id=9f3b2e7a-1c4a-4d7b-8f1a-3b2c4d5e6f70 tokens/s=1161.9 p50=12.1ms p95=26.0ms p99=49.0ms vram_pct=73
```
sanjay: Ops, please add a gating rule so runs labeled --aggregated-only cannot accidentally enable raw uploads.
ops-bot: Noted. Action created: SF-PREVIEW-1 (attach countersigned NDA), SF-PREVIEW-2 (bench dry-run Tue 14:00), SF-PREVIEW-3 (enforce aggregated-only gate).
meera: I'll chase the countersign and update this thread. If countersign arrives EOD, schedule stays. If not, we move by +48h.
owen: I'll add a --si-debug-token flag that requires explicit token to enable raw trace uploads and will default to off. Also adding --upload-sample-json to push aggregated payloads only.
pat: Marketing checklist: NDA signed, perf mini-report, design approvals, co-marketing sign-off. I'll own the checklist and loop in design once perf is posted.
sanjay: Great. Next sync Thurs 11:00 to confirm countersign and runbook. Please keep updates short here.
meera: Looping in @sophia and ops in #legal-partnerships and #eng-infra now.
pat: :thumbsup:
nowen: I'll post a short summary after dry-run in this thread.
sophia: Countersign status: queued; expecting partner exec sign-off within 24h. Will update legal thread.
sanjay: Thanks all.
